ios.desc:
"Noodles and Noodles2 are in my top 5 favorite games. Kudos to the developers for taking a game I absolutely loved and making it even better!"
  - App store review

"5 out of 5.  Michael, the new features are wonderful....Zoey and I approve."  
  - Michael's sister.

Noodles! is back and better than ever.

Noodles 2 has more puzzles, more challenges, more fun, and an even more zen experience.
 
Noodles 2 is a relaxing puzzle game that will leave you feeling stress-free while strengthening your noodle. It's a very friendly kind of puzzle.  You don't have to come to it with any sort of knowledge beforehand - just bring your brain.

One simple rule: Tap the noodles to rotate, and connect all the noodles together to complete the puzzle.  That's it!!  I guess that's two rules...

You will soon discover a calming sense of order and the rush of satisfaction at a connected puzzle.  Now if only all life's puzzles were as straightforward...
 
Key Features:
- Thousands of addicting puzzles, unlocked all at once. No timers, gem crates, or unbeatable levels.
- Classic game mode to begin, all the way up to challenge puzzles that wrap around infinitely.
- Increasing difficulty makes you feel smarter when you are done.
- Classic game mode, plus 3 all-new challenge modes. 
- Does one of the modes have puzzle pieces which are also ghosts? Yes.
- No heptagons in sight.
- Wraparound puzzles will let you achieve your dream of playing a puzzle on a cylinder.
- Light and dark modes, each more relaxing than the other.
- Customizable premium colors, so you can Noodle in your favourite theme.
- Cloud saves, to bring with you to a new phone. The cloud!

From the bumbling geniuses at Lummox Labs, who brought you the original Noodles! which achieved:

Over 1.5 million downloads
4.5 stars
App Store App of the Week
Starbucks Pick of the Week

quotes.text:
Well, this seems an appropriate place to plug the phone/tablet app we made with these puzzles, called Noodles 2.

It's the same puzzle style, with square, triangle and hex shapes, with some extra mechanics - disappearing pieces, infinite grid (it wraps around).

gereleth, great job on the puzzles - I played a few of the bigger hex puzzles and it was real smooth. :)
